posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
It has been about six weeks, and I want to make sure to get an update out to all of you before the end of the month!

Completed Since Last Update

1) Sentinel Tactics Minions miniatures & Interior Location Maps shipping.

Finished by Printer; In GTG Warehouse

 1) Bottom of the Ninth (US Backer Shipments have gone out, and international shipments will all go out this week!)

At the Printer; About to be Loaded

 (The printer tells us that these will depart China on the 20th)

1) Villains of the Multiverse and associated mini-expansions

2) New set of Oversized Villain Cards

3) Isle of Trains, Diner, and Brew Crafters: The Travel Card Game reprints

4) Wager Master reprint

5) Compounded reprint

Completed by GTG; At the Printer

1) SotM: Core Game, Rook City & Infernal Relics, Vengeance, and Miss Information reprints

In the Final Graphic Design stage at GTG; to Printer in ~60 Days

1) New Bedford (to printer in ~10 days)

2) Great Heartland Hauling reprint (to printer in ~30 days)

3) Spirit Island (to printer in ~60 days)

Current Game Developtment Focus by GTG

1) Sentinel Tactics: Battle for Broken City and For Profit

2) Sentinel Comics: The Role Playing Game

3) Various Dice Hate Me Games properties
